explication: go-trader is a hybrid crypto trading system: a persistent Go scheduler coordinates short-lived Python strategy checks, then manages paper/live execution, risk, state, and operator-facing alerts and status. Its separate research workflow evaluates strategies through backtests and regime/Hurst studies. The README establishes the main runtime handoffs and supported capabilities; some internal links and implementation details are not visible in the sampled source, so uncertain connections are omitted or marked dashed.
